summary:
Space Mission Design Game is an interactive, browser-based aerospace simulation prototype built using HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript. Players design multi-stage rockets, configure avionics and propulsion subsystems, manage mission budgets, and execute real-time orbital launches across targets like Low Earth Orbit, the Moon, and Mars.
​By integrating authentic astrodynamics—such as the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation, planetary phase-angle launch windows, cold-gas RCS maneuvering, and cryogenic propellant boil-off—the game bridges complex orbital engineering with accessible visual simulation. This makes it an impactful educational and hackathon tool for demonstrating real-world spaceflight constraints, trade-off analysis, and mission planning interactively.
